changelog: Fix: after renaming the Coming Soon library, the old name could linger as a phantom library in apps (e.g. Moonfin). The plugin now looks the library up by folder before every scan and never refreshes an entry whose folder no longer exists. Run Scan All Libraries once to remove an existing phantom.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
